commissary._note: Selection model: wiki names 7 fixed combinations A-G (unpublished contents); sim infers uniform random draw of `slots` distinct available entries. upgrade_disk_commissary competes for those slots like any other entry, so it is offered on roughly 4-in-13 days until spent.

stock._note: food restores steps via the engine food item pipeline
Listed as 'Set of Gems' on the wiki. Grants 3 gems (count unpublished; using 3, confidence inferred).

locksmith._note: Key and set_of_3_keys are unlimited (no limit field). lock_pick_kit carries not_if_owned=true: not offered when already held. special_key is a separate roll block (one per day at 8g).

special_key._note: One special key offered per day at 8g. Priority lists rolled 30/40/30. Fallback list tried in order: car_keys first, then a duplicate silver_key. Source: wiki/Locksmith.

showroom._note: Stock model: pick 2 from tier_a + 2 from tier_b avoiding already-owned; trophy only offered once all four displayed items are bought. Tier prices are wiki-documented.

gift_shop._note: Full Gift Shop inventory not published on the wiki. lunch_box: one_time=true — only offered when lunch_box unlock flag is absent (engine-enforced). cursed_coffers: not a special_items.json id; modeled as a container that grants cursed_effigy when the player holds a sledge_hammer. Price 10g is inferred (unpublished).

stock._note: One-time post-game unlock. Only offered when not lunch_box_unlocked. After purchase, spawns daily in every Dining Room.
Price 10g is inferred (wiki does not publish it). Buying it grants the cursed_effigy immediately; steps-to-13 pickup effect applies. Records cursed_effigy_unlocked for carry-over.

the_armory._note: Four stock entries. The wiki shows four slots: Knight's Shield, Morning Star, Torch, and The Axe. The real third-slot rotation (between Torch and other items) is unmodeled; all four are listed as static stock.

kitchen._note: Real menu: 5 bananas (2g), 1 club sandwich (8g), plus one daily special rolled 40/30/30 (bacon_and_eggs/chef_salad/tomato_soup). The special is rolled by _roll_kitchen on first entry using the shop_stock substream.

bookshop._note: Modeled as a shop with no purchasable stock. Lore books sold in the Bookshop are not modeled in the sim (lore out of scope). Stock array is empty until book purchases are implemented.

laundry_room._note: Modeled as a shop with no purchasable stock. The Laundry Room's coin/step swap mechanic is not modeled in the sim. Stock array is empty until laundry swaps are implemented.
